text:
deploy-bot: [AUTOMATION] canary-promotion FAILED for worker-service:v2026.03.21-rc
deploy-bot: reason=layer-extract-error; registry response=400 Bad Request; tar: unexpected EOF; cache-index lock held by upload-8372

jen: saw this in the canary smoke logs, bad extract on the sidecar layer. do we have a fallback? :eyes:

mike: blocking the release if canary can't promote. we should pin to last-good image and manual promote while infra investigates.

liam: quick triage: looks like the registry returned a truncated blob for layer sha256:8a7f... which caused tar EOF. probably a partial upload + cache index still references it.

sara: agree with pin. also: pause automated promotions for this pipeline until we confirm registry integrity.

jen: what image tag do we pin to?

mike: pin to worker-service:v2026.03.18 (smokes green in staging, ran at 1702400000).

liam: proposed steps:
1) pause promote automation (deployctl toggle-auto-promote --pipeline=canary --off)
2) manual promote last-good image
3) run canary smoke (10m)
4) if green, promote to stable
5) open infra ticket and quarantine bad blob

mike: manual commands I ran locally (share for ops):
```bash
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/worker worker=registry.redwood.ai/worker:v20260318 --record
deployctl promote --image=registry.redwood.ai/worker:v20260318 --env=canary --reason="manual pin after extract-failure"
```

ops-bot: manual promote initiated by mike at 1702501252, job=promote-7362, watching logs.

jen: smoke started -> curl /health returns 200 on 3/3 pods, latency OK.

alex: approved manual promote to canary and hold on auto. Alex: we will not promote to stable until infra confirms registry fix. add to release notes: "promotion paused due to artifact extraction failure; manual pin to v2026.03.18 performed; investigation open."

sara: created ticket INFRA-1298 with logs and blob sha; assigned to eng-infra (liam). priority=P1.

liam: I'll run registry blob-verify and storage checksum scan overnight. initial hypothesis: upstream proxy truncated a layer during a transient network failure causing checksum mismatch on read.

mike: thanks. for the release timeline: we delay stable cut by 1 hour to accommodate manual validation. I'll update the release notes and slack #release-notes once stable promote is done.

jen: tiny followup - anyone saw similar in other services? I grepped recent canary logs; no other occurrences in last 24h.

liam: noted. if we see repeats, we need to force reupload of impacted artifacts and invalidate cache-index entries.

alex: consensus: pin to last-good, manual promote, pause auto-promote, infra ticket created, monitor for recurrence. Reopen thread if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
